incidents.title: Docker dependency installation exceeded CPU threshold

timeline.title: CPU threshold exceeded
timeline.text: Docker CPU reached 91%; the run still completed successfully.

recommendations.title: Pass the test token into the container at runtime
recommendations.description: Expose the configured CI test secret to the test process without storing it in the Docker image.
recommendations.impact: Restore authentication for checkout integration tests
evidence: The Docker test command did not forward AUTH_TOKEN.
The test workflow expects a TEST_TOKEN secret; its actual configuration must be checked during backend integration.

diff.text: run: docker run --rm nexus-test pytest tests/integration
run: docker run --rm --env AUTH_TOKEN nexus-test pytest tests/integration

recommendations.title: Reuse Docker dependency layers
recommendations.description: Copy dependency manifests before application code and retain pip downloads in a BuildKit cache mount.
recommendations.impact: Estimated reduction: up to 2m 38s per warm build; requires validation
evidence: CPU peaked at 91% and memory at 78%.
Copying application code before installing dependencies invalidates the dependency layer on every code change.
